title: The birth of Rosaria Mazza — 28 October 1879
what: Act 167. Mazza Pasquale, fifty, a bracciante of Piedimonte Etneo, declares a daughter born at half past six the previous morning in the house on Via Terremorte, to Greco Concetta, industriosa, his wife. A marginal note adds that she married Giuseppe Monforte, son of the late Salvatore, on 26 April 1903.
cite: Piedimonte Etneo, Stato civile italiano, Nati 1879, atto 167 — Archivio di Stato di Catania (Antenati an_ua83492, img 74)

title: The M page of the 1879 annual index
what: The complete M section of the Indice Annuale for Piedimonte Etneo births, 1879. Twenty-three surnames — Morabito, Messina, Monforte, Masano, Musumeci, Moschella, Monti, Mangano, Mangeri — and exactly two Mazza: Rosaria at act 167 and Venerio at act 205. There is no Salvatore.
cite: Piedimonte Etneo, Stato civile italiano, Nati 1879, Indice annuale, p. 72 — Archivio di Stato di Catania (Antenati an_ua83492, img 79)

title: The annual index, page 72
what: The full opening. The index runs alphabetically over the last pages of the volume and covers the whole year, including the acts filed in the supplementary volume — which is how act 205 appears here although it is not in this book.
cite: Piedimonte Etneo, Stato civile italiano, Nati 1879, Indice annuale, p. 72 — Archivio di Stato di Catania (Antenati an_ua83492, img 79)
